checker_notes: Searched for missed model systems: abrocitinib/PF-04965842 in imiquimod, xenograft or skin-explant psoriasis models (none; only a DNCB atopic-dermatitis mouse study); itacitinib/INCB039110 psoriasis models (none; Covington 2020 covers arthritis, IBD, GvHD); solcitinib/GSK2586184 preclinical pharmacology (none public, vendor IC50s only); ex-vivo/3D human psoriatic skin with JAK1-selective drugs (none; tofacitinib keratinocyte cultures, a JAK1/3 3D-skin study, SAR-20347 JAK1/TYK2 imiquimod work and a pan-JAK psoriatic-skin xenograft abstract are all outside the member list). No press release, SEC filing or EMA document reporting an undisclosed failure was found; all three Phase 2s were positive and none went further. Could not open Vazquez 2018 full text (ACS paywall), so the rat-AIA effective dose/exposure remains unverified. Cosmetic: tile gives area/disease as lowercase 'autoimmune'/'psoriasis', draft capitalises; house-style contexts capitalise and v3 drafts are split (6 'Autoimmune' vs 2 'autoimmune'); lint passes either way.
rule_questions: Cross-indication efficacy track: decision 8 opens a cell on the filed cross-indication model, the drafter brief says a class that went to patients on another indication's data leaves the cell empty, and decision 12 lets cross-indication evidence transfer for safety only. Can a cross_indication efficacy track ever score same/contra, is it untested by construction, or should the cell be blank?

Decision 16 with no stated effective exposure: the monkey NOAEL margin held and patients were dosed to clinical effect, but no model source ever stated an effective exposure target. Does 'dosed to target' require a stated target, or does the clinically effective dose stand in for it?

magnitude 'opposite' is defined (decision 5) for a predicted harm that never appeared. When the model predicted the absence of a harm (JAK2-axis sparing) and the harm appeared, is that 'opposite', 'direction_only', or null?

Does an expectation sentence in a model paper's abstract ('a JAK1-selective inhibitor would be expected to ... avoid inhibition of the JAK2 homodimer') count as the model's stated safety prediction, given #111 sets aside mechanism-attribution sentences that name no species or study?
